fields.FIR_Description: The reported incident took place on 2025-07-30 (afternoon, 13:40): The complainant contributed to a local chit group, and after the organiser failed to pay the maturity amount of Rs. 1,20,000, contact was lost. The account reference SYN-ACC-100079 was noted in connection with the payment. A witness, Praveen Balan, reachable on 9000000446, was mentioned in the complaint. The complaint refers to Nandha Natarajan, a business acquaintance, reachable on 9000000393. Suspicion was reportedly directed towards Ezhilan Ramasamy, using the number 9000000042. The complainant mentioned digital documents and a bank transaction reference.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Chit contributions reportedly collected in cash and through transfers.
fields.Keywords: chit fund, financial fraud, bank reference, mobile number, receiving account, digital document, witness, associate
